name: Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc.

corporate_actions.event: FQ1 2027 results: sales +7.6%, organic +7.1%; FY27 EPS guide raised to $11.70-12.20

geography.fx_notes: Canada and Mexico ~12% of Service Center segment sales (FACT, S1); Service Center is the majority segment, so INFERENCE: US ~85-88% of group, Australia/NZ/Singapore small (~3%).

kpis.name: Engineered Solutions organic growth
kpis.value: +14.1%; orders +30%; automation >+20%; fluid power high-teens (semis & data centres)

company_fcf.definition: OCF less capex; ~67% of NI (working-capital build)

lease.source_id: US GAAP filer; not disclosed in sources reviewed

acquisitions.notes: Acquisitions added 0.3pt to growth; M&A top capital priority with mid-size targets in diligence. Prior deals (e.g., Hydradyne fluid power, automation bolt-ons) not re-verified.

management.succession_notes: CEO tenure ~15 years; succession planning not disclosed in sources
management.guidance_record: Generally met/raised; FY27 sales guide 4-6.5% maintained, EPS nudged up

evidence: Break-fix technical MRO (bearings, power transmission) is repeat [S1]
A.rationale: Mixed: MRO core is durable, ES is project-cyclical.

evidence: Largest US fluid power distributor with system engineering [S1]
Technical application expertise and supplier authorisations
B.rationale: Technical specification and authorised-distributor status create differentiation.

D.rationale: Good runway in automation and fluid power plus M&A.

evidence: Fluid power high-teens growth from semiconductor and data-centre markets [S1]
Technology vertical called a 'durable growth driver' [S1]
I2.rationale: INFERENCE: technology vertical (semis + DC) likely ~5-10% of sales; rising.

evidence: Shared services and sales productivity tools [S1]
FCF conversion varies with working capital [S1]

ai.notes: Technology vertical (semiconductor + data centre) explicitly cited as growth driver in fluid power/automation; not quantified. INFERENCE combined 5-10% of sales. Not an AI diversifier by default; monitor G5.

sector_specific.notes: acquisition_growth_pct = Q1 FY27 (FACT). Aggregates/lumber verticals are construction-adjacent (declining in Q1). Semis+DC undisclosed, inferred 5-10%.

gates.notes: G5: technology vertical inferred 5-10% (<15%) but undisclosed -> monitor; leverage 0.3x; FCF/NI low in Q1 due to working capital (annual typically >90%, verify centrally).

bull_points: Engineered Solutions organic +14% with orders +30% and record backlog (S1)
Net leverage 0.3x gives M&A and buyback capacity (S1)
Automation demand driven by structural labour constraints (S1)
bear_points: Growth increasingly tied to semis/data-centre capex cycles (S1)
Service Center growth slowed to 3.5% organic; Canada/Mexico soft (S1)
Price ~2% of growth; LIFO and inflation volatility (S1)
thesis_breakers: Technology (semis+DC) vertical disclosed above 15% of sales
Service Center organic growth negative for 4 quarters outside recession
EBITDA margin below 11.5% for a full year

sources.title: Applied Industrial Technologies (AIT) Q1 FY2027 earnings call transcript
